lines.beaver_en: How's the mood at your company these days?
lines.learner: 솔직히 노사 갈등 때문에 좀 시끄러워요.
lines.en: Honestly, it's a bit chaotic because of labor-management conflict.
lines.roman: Soljjiki nosa galdeung ttaemune jom sikkeureowoyo.

lines.en: Management says there's less work, so they'll cut labor costs.
The junior staff are even calling for a strike.

lines.beaver_en: A strike? Is it that serious?
lines.learner: 심각하다고 할 것까지는 없지만 불만이 커요.
lines.en: It's not so much serious, but there's a lot of frustration.
lines.roman: Simgakadago hal geotkkajineun eopjiman bulmani keoyo.

lines.learner: 업무 분담이 불공평하고 공로도 인정을 안 해 줘요.
lines.en: Work is divided unfairly, and our contributions aren't recognized.
lines.roman: Eommu bundami bulgongpyeonghago gongnodo injeongeul an hae jwoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Why not talk to your team leader?
lines.learner: 직속 상사에게 말할라치면 늘 바쁘다고 해요.
lines.en: Whenever I try to talk to my direct boss, he says he's busy.
lines.roman: Jikssok sangsaege malhallachimyeon neul bappeudago haeyo.

lines.beaver: 그나저나 지금 무슨 일을 맡고 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: By the way, what are you in charge of now?
lines.beaver_roman: Geunajeona jigeum museun ireul matkko isseoyo?
lines.learner: 저는 신규 고객 관리를 전담하고 있어요.
lines.en: I'm solely in charge of managing new clients.
lines.roman: Jeoneun singyu gogaek gwallireul jeondamhago isseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Then you must have quite a lot of work.
lines.learner: 네, 혼자 하니까 일이 엄청 많아요.
lines.en: Yes, I do it alone, so I have a ton of work.
lines.roman: Ne, honja hanikka iri eomcheong manayo.

lines.beaver_en: If there's a strike, will you join?
lines.learner: 설사 파업을 한다고 해도 일은 해야죠.
lines.en: Even if there is a strike, I still have to work.
lines.roman: Seolsa paeobeul handago haedo ireun haeyajyo.

lines.beaver_en: I hope labor and management settle it soon.
lines.en: Yes, I hope they reach an agreement as soon as possible.
